title.original: Laminar: A Scalable Asynchronous RL Post-Training Framework
title.zh: Laminar：可扩展的异步强化学习后训练框架
title.en: Laminar: A Scalable Asynchronous RL Post-Training Framework

inclusion_reason.zh: Laminar 的分布式参数中继、逐轨迹异步、长尾重打包和故障隔离构成千卡级 RL 后训练运行时。
inclusion_reason.en: Laminar's distributed parameter relays, per-trajectory asynchrony, tail repacking, and failure isolation form a thousand-GPU-scale RL post-training runtime.

abstract.zh: Laminar 以轨迹级异步取代全局权重同步，使用中继 worker 组成分布式参数服务，并把长尾轨迹动态重打包到专用 rollout 实例。
abstract.en: Laminar replaces global synchronization with trajectory-level asynchrony, uses relay workers as a distributed parameter service, and dynamically repacks long-tail trajectories onto dedicated rollout instances.

problem.zh: 轨迹生成时延呈强长尾，现有异步系统仍要求 actor 与全部 rollout 全局同步权重，导致快 worker 被慢轨迹和刚性更新节奏阻塞。
problem.en: Trajectory latency is strongly heavy-tailed, yet existing asynchronous systems still globally synchronize actor and rollout weights, blocking fast workers behind slow trajectories and rigid update epochs.

approach.zh: 中继层允许 rollout 随时拉取较新权重，训练循环无需停顿；动态重打包把异常长轨迹集中处理，同时解耦模块隔离单点失败。
approach.en: Relay workers let rollouts pull fresh weights without pausing training; dynamic repacking consolidates unusually long trajectories, and decoupled components isolate failures.

system_design.zh: actor 持续更新策略，中继参数层分发细粒度版本，rollout 池逐轨迹拉取与提交，重打包控制器监测时延并迁移长尾任务。
system_design.en: The actor continuously updates policy, a relay parameter tier distributes fine-grained versions, the rollout pool pulls and submits per trajectory, and a repacking controller monitors latency and moves tail work.

key_results.zh: 千卡级评测中，Laminar 相比先进系统显著提升训练吞吐并缩短收敛时间，长尾越强时收益越明显。
key_results.en: At thousand-GPU scale, Laminar materially improves training throughput and convergence time over advanced systems, with larger benefits under stronger latency tails.

limitations.zh: 轨迹级异步仍需控制策略陈旧性；中继层和任务迁移增加一致性与网络复杂度，故障隔离效果也依赖外部存储可靠性。
limitations.en: Trajectory-level asynchrony still requires staleness control; relay and migration layers add consistency and network complexity, while fault isolation depends on durable external state.

workloads: asynchronous RL post-training with long-tail trajectories
